description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.04.2022 to 10.04.2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance, establishing new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade and customs operations, issued by the Director General of Customs using statutory powers.
